title: Insurance Claim Repairs Storage Rate Card
content:
Storage on an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order is rated per class. The card gives the free collection days and daily storage rate billed to the customer, the free removal days and daily storage rate billed to the insurer on a total-loss vehicle, and the desk's goodwill authority against customer-pay storage.

## Rate card

| Repair class | Pickup free days (calendar days after the vehicle-ready date) | Storage per calendar day, customer | Total-loss removal free days (calendar days after the total-loss date) | Total-loss storage per calendar day, insurer | Desk goodwill authority per repair order |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Claim Repair | 2 | USD 45.00 | 3 | USD 55.00 | USD 45.00 |
| Standard Claim Repair | 2 | USD 45.00 | 3 | USD 55.00 | USD 45.00 |
| Major Claim Repair | 2 | USD 55.00 | 3 | USD 65.00 | USD 55.00 |
| Structural Claim Repair | 3 | USD 65.00 | 3 | USD 75.00 | USD 65.00 |
| Certified Structural Claim Repair | 3 | USD 65.00 | 3 | USD 75.00 | USD 65.00 |
| Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair | 3 | USD 75.00 | 3 | USD 85.00 | USD 75.00 |

## Definitions

- **Pickup free days** — calendar days after the vehicle-ready date during which the vehicle may be collected without storage.
- **Customer storage rate** — storage per calendar day for a completed or withdrawn vehicle not collected in time.
- **Total-loss removal free days** — calendar days after the total-loss date the insurer has to remove the vehicle before storage is billed to it.
- **Total-loss storage rate** — storage per calendar day billed to the insurer on a total-loss vehicle not removed in time.
- **Goodwill authority** — the most the desk may credit as goodwill against customer-pay storage on one repair order.

## Rate examples (hypothetical stays)

- Four billed storage days in Major Claim Repair: 4 days at USD 55.00, a total of USD 220.00.
- Two billed storage days in Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair: 2 days at USD 75.00, a total of USD 150.00.
- In Structural Claim Repair the goodwill authority of USD 65.00 equals one day of customer storage at that class's rate.
